title: Christina Lake 原位油砂
summary: Christina Lake 是 Cenovus 的 SAGD 案例；教學比較蒸汽熱需求、回收水與稀釋劑物流的不同計量基準。本課依序分析蒸汽熱量分母選擇、回水品質與用量、外輸稀釋劑需求、回水帶回顯熱、循環庫存校正，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Christina Lake is a Cenovus SAGD case; teaching compares metering bases for steam heat, recycled water and diluent logistics. The course analyses selecting the steam-duty denominator, returned-water quality and quantity, export diluent demand, sensible heat returned with water, correcting for cycle inventory, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.

v31FocusEn: Selecting the steam-duty denominator; Returned-water quality and quantity; Export diluent demand

steps.title: 蒸汽熱量分母選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selecting the steam-duty denominator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蒸汽熱量分母選擇」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Selecting the steam-duty denominator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = Qo SOR rho Δh/86400；代入 Qo = 1150 m³ oil/day、SOR = 2.8 m³ cold-water-equivalent/m³ oil、dh = 2200 kJ/kg，得 82.0 MW（「蒸汽熱量分母選擇」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 SOR 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = Qo SOR rho Δh/86400; with Qo = 1150 m³ oil/day, SOR = 2.8 m³ cold-water-equivalent/m³ oil, dh = 2200 kJ/kg the result is 82.0 MW (simplified exercise for Selecting the steam-duty denominator; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise SOR by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：SOR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 90.2 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising SOR by 10% changes the result to 90.2 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 82.0 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 SOR 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 82.0 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in SOR with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 針對「蒸汽熱量分母選擇」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把蒸汽量全部轉成冷水等值體積，再以相同時間窗求比值；使用熱平衡檢查蒸汽焓升與回水帶回的熱量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Selecting the steam-duty denominator”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Convert all steam quantities to cold-water-equivalent volume before calculating ratios over matched intervals, then reconcile enthalpy rise with heat returned in produced water. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 057-01 and mark charts “Christina Lake in-situ project: teaching assumptions”. Report cold-water-equivalent basis, time window and thermal inventory boundary without specifying injection settings or field operating procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「蒸汽熱量分母選擇」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Selecting the steam-duty denominator” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More water recycling removes the need for water-quality monitoring." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「回水品質與用量」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把回流量重複加到總需求會高估節水效益；若排污未入帳，鹽分平衡與水量平衡可能得出互相矛盾的結論。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Returned-water quality and quantity” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Counting return flow twice inflates apparent savings; omitted purge flow can also make salt and water balances contradict each other.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
